budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY24 budget was 32% expended in month 5, with spending behind schedule because of staff vacancies.
budget_items.quote: fy24 budget is 32% expended. we are in month 5 of the fiscal year.

budget_items.topic: Library share of town budget and fixed salary costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The library is about 1.4% of the annual town budget, and about one third of the $601k budget is fixed salary costs.
budget_items.quote: the library is about 1.4% of the annual town budget. approximately 1/3 of the $601k budget is dedicated to fixed salary costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The newly approved clerical union contract includes an 18-20% increase over 3 years plus a market adjustment.
A $14k request for building maintenance was to be broken down in more detail and coordinated with the DPW head.
budget_items.quote: michael-ray suggested breaking down the $14k requested for building maintenance into more detail and coordinating the budgeting with the dpw head.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A request for an additional $9k for programs brings the total to $20k; program costs were said to have risen almost 50% in recent years.
budget_items.quote: there is a request for an additional $9k for programs, $20k total.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The CWMARS Network membership assessment is increasing by $3120 to $23k.
budget_items.quote: the cwmars network membership assessment is increasing by $3120 to $23k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The office supplies request rose 50%, from $6k to $12k.
budget_items.quote: request for office supplies increased by 50%, from $6k to $12k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Library Materials line item has a $7500 increase, to $93k.
budget_items.quote: library materials line item has a $7500 increase, to $93k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new training and professional development line item requests $2k.
budget_items.quote: training and professional development is a new line item. $2k is requested.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new technology purchase line item requests $14k, which Michael-Ray said needs justification.
budget_items.quote: technology purchase is a new line item. $14k is requested.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A capital request for security camera replacement has quotes of $80k for 24 cameras, $40k for 12 cameras, and $35K for a lower tier of devices.
budget_items.quote: muir has quotes of $80k for 24 cameras, $40k for 12 cameras, $35k for a lower tier of camera devices.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An estimate of $6387 was obtained for the sign only; gooseneck lighting above the sign is also needed.
budget_items.quote: he got an estimate of $6387 for the sign only.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Michael-Ray recommended spending the ARPA money as soon as possible; Harry said funds must be spent within the required time. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: michael-ray recommends that we spend the money asap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The invested funds have been pretty static; the director stays current on reporting to the town. No dollar figure printed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Friends' book sale brought in about $1500.
